spans.s:
ind.
1 A particle and prefix implying certainty, assurance.
2 Negation, privation.
3 Outside, out, without, forth.
E.
नृ to guide, affix क्विप्.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
1 Having no dice, &c.
2 Having no latitude.
m. (-क्षः)
(In Astronomy,) The terrestrial equator.
E.
निर्, and अक्ष a die, &c.

m. (-शः)
1 A first meridian, as Laṅkā, a place where the sun is always vertical, and the days and nights are equal.
2 The equatorial region.
E.
निर्, अक्ष latitude, देश a country.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Unchecked, uncontrolled, self-willed.
E.
निर् privative, अङ्कुश a hook for guiding an elephant.

n. (-त्वं)
Self-will, wilfulness.
E.
त्व added to the foregoing; also with तल्, निरङ्कशता.

mfn. (-ग्निः-ग्निः-ग्नि)
Having lost or neglected the consecrated fire.
E.
निर्, अग्नि fire.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Void of passion or emotion.
2 Unstained, unblackened.
n. (-नं)
The Supreme Being.
f. (-ना)
The day of fullmoon.
E.
नि neg. रञ्जन affection; or निर् not, अञ्जन collyrium; figuratively, darkness.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Engaged or interested in.
2 Attached or devoted to.
E.
नि, and रत occupied.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Indifferent, not taking pleasure in.
2 Stopped, staying.
E.
नि neg. रत engaged in, इ made long.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Faultless, unblamable.
E.
निर् neg. अत्यय fault.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Hard-hearted, destitute of compassion.
E.
निर्, and अनुक्रोश pity.

f. (-ता)
Cruelty, hard-heartedness.
E.
तल् added to the last.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Unkind, unfavourable.
E.
निर् neg. अनुरोध favour.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Coarse, gross, without interstices.
2

Continuous.
3

Uninterrupted, continual.
4

Unbounded.
5

Identical, not different.
6 Unconcealed, not hidden or vanished.
9 Not external, &c.
E.
निर् not, अन्तर interval, difference, &c.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Narrow, contracted.
E.
निर् neg. अन्तराल intermediate space.

m. (-सः)
1 Private study, reading to one's self the sacred works.
2 Diligent and uninterrupted pursuit, exercise, practice.
E.
निर् not, अन्तर between, अभ्यास practice.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Childless, having no family.
2 Unconnected with, not belonging or related to.
3 Done in one's absence, not done openly or visibly.
4 Unmethodical, ill arranged.
E.
निर् neg. अन्वय descent, connexion.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Destitute of water.
E.
निर्, and अप water.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
1 Shameless, impudent.
2 Bold, confident.
E.
निर् not, अपत्रप shame.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Faultless, blameless.
E.
निर् neg. अपराध fault.

m. (-र्त्तः)
1 Non-returning or turning back.
2 (In Arithmetic,) Leaving no common measure.
E.
निर्, and अपवर्त्त returning.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Free from destruction or decay, eternal.
E.
निर् neg. अपाय loss.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
1 Independant of, unconnected or unconcerned with.
2 Careless, indifferent, negligent.
3 Without purpose or hope.
E.
निर्, and अपेक्षा regard to.

mfn. (-ब्भ्रः-ब्भ्रा-ब्भ्रं)
Cloudless.
E.
निर्, and अब्भ्र a cloud.

m. (-यः)
Hell.
E.
निर् out, beyond, अय good fortune.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Having no income or profit, yielding none, &c.
E.
निर् neg. आय receipt.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Unobstructed, unrestrained, unimpeded.
E.
निर् not, अर्गल a bolt or bar.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Vain, fruitless, unprofitable.
2 Unmeaning.
E.
निर् not, अर्थं object, end, कन् added.

m. (-वः)
Loss of voice.
E.
नि neg. and रव sound.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Self-willed, headstrong, independant, uncontrolled.
E.
निर् neg. अवग्रह control.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Unobjectionable, unexceptionable.
E.
निर् neg. अवद्य not to be said.

ind.
Fully, particularly, circumstantially.
E.
निर् neg. अवशेषतस् a remainder.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Animated, anxious, eager.
E.
निर् neg. अवसाद languor.

f. (-का)
A fence, a hedge, an outer wall.
E.
निर् out, without, and अवहालिका a fence.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Undecaying, eternal.
E.
निर् neg. अव्यय.

n. (-नं)
Fasting, going without food.
E.
निर्, and अशन eating.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
What removes, expels, subdues, checks, &c.
n. (-नं)
1 Rejection, denial, contradiction, disallowance.
2 Suppressing, checking.
3

Appeasing.
4

Expelling, ejecting.
5 Spitting, spitting out any thing with sickness or disgust.
6 Killing, destroying.
E.
निर् out or forth, अस to throw, affix ल्युट् or युच्.

n. (-नं)
1 Rejection, contradiction.
2 Killing, destroying.
3 Spitting out.
E.
निर् before अस् to be, &c. with आङ् prefixed, and ल्युट् affix; also निरासन.

Dry.
2

Insipid, tasteless.
m. (-सः)
1 Insipidity, want of flavour or passion.
2 Dryness, want of juice.
E.
नि neg. रस juice, &c. also निरस.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
1 Hopeless, despairing.
2 Disappointed.
E.
निर्, and आश hope.

m. (-सः)
1 Opposing, rejecting.
2

Dispension.
3

Ejecting, expelling.
4

Removal.
5

Abandonment.
E.
निर् out, and आस throwing.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Dry, withered, insipid, devoid of taste, &c. morally or physically.
m. (-सः)
The pomegranate.
E.
नी for निर् negative or affirmative prefix, and रस juice, flavour.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Expelled, sent forth or out.
2 Sent, thrown, cast, directed.
3 Thrown off, (as from a horse.)
4 Abandoned, deserted, left.
5 Rejected, disallowed.
6 Shot, (as an arrow.)
7 Uttered rapidly, hurried.
8 Destroyed. []
9 Gone, absent, what is not.
10 Suppressed, checked.
11 Torn or taken.
12 Broken, (as an agreement.)
E.
निर् out or forth, अस to throw or send, affix क्त.

ind.
1 Having ejected or thrown out.
2 Having expelled, &c.
E.
निर्, and अस to throw, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-स्यन्-स्यन्ती-स्यत्)
1 Ejecting, thrown out.
2 Abandoning, neglecting.
3

Expelling.
4

Scattering.
5

Destroying, &c.
E.
निर् out, अस to throw, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being suppressed or checked.
2 Being abandoned.
3

Suppressing.
4

Expelling.
5

Scattering, &c.
E.
निर् before अस to throw, either a. or p. voice, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Humble, free from pride.
E.
निर् neg. अहङ्कार pride.

m. (-णं)
1 Obstruction, opposition, contradiction, rejection.
2 Refutation, reply.
3 Holding in no consideration, making light of, contempt, disesteem.
4 Expelling, turning out or away.
5 Throwing out or off.
6 Neglecting the chief sacrificial or religious duties.
E.
निर् privative particle, and आङ् before कृ to do or make, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
1 Obstructive, obstructing.
2 Disdaining, despising.
E.
निर्, and आङ् before कृ, affix इष्णुच्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Devoid of form or figure.
m. (-रः)
1

Heaven.
2
VIṢṆ
Ś

IVA.
4
The divine spirit,

God.
5

Reproach, censure.
E.
निर् implying negative or depreciation, and आकार shape, &c.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Calm, steady, unperplexed, unconfused.
E.
निर् neg. आकुल agitated.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Removed, rejected, set aside.
2 Refuted, replied to.
3 Made light of, contemned, despised.
4 Expelled, turned out.
5 Thrown from or off.
2 Divorced.
E.
निरा, and कृत done, with आङ् prefixed.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
1 A person who has not duly gone through a course of study, especially applied however to the religious student, who has not duly read the

Vedas.
2

One who neglects the five great religious obligations.
3 Shapeless, formless, viewless.
m. (-तिः)
1 Rejection, contradiction, opposition, disallowance.
2 Obstacle, impediment.
E.
निरा implying privation or obstruction, कृति making, causing; or निर् privative, and आकृति form.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Unaccused, unreviled.
E.
निर्, and आक्रोश exclaiming.

mfn. (-गाः-गाः-गः)
Sinless, faultless.
E.
निर् neg. आगस् sin.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Lawless, corrupt, barbarian, depraved.
E.
निर् not, आचार moral ordinance: it is especially applied to those people who have not the ordinances of the Vedas or distinction of Castes, &c. and comprises all, therefore, except Hindūs.

f. (-पा)
Night.
E.
निर् not, none, and आतप sunshine.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Given, paid, delivered.
E.
निर्, and अदिष्ट shown.

m. (-शः)
Payment, discharge, delivery.
E.
निर्, and आङ्दिश to show, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-न्दः-न्दा-न्दं)
Causing no pleasure, undelighting.
E.
निर् neg. आनन्द happiness.

mfn. (-द् or -त्)
Prosperous, fortunate.
E.
निर् neg. आपद misfortune.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Frivolously or unreally vexatious, (as a cause of complaint.)
E.
निर् privative, आङ् before बाधा pain, annoyance.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Well, hale, recovered from sickness.
m. (-यः)
1 A wild goat.
2 A hog, a boar.
E.
निर् not, आमय sickness.

m. (-लुः)
The wood apple: see कपित्थ.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
1 Living without meat.
2 Free from sensual desires.
E.
निर्, आमिष flesh, अशिन् who eats.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Contracted, compact.
E.
निर् neg. आयत spread.

m. (-वान्)
An idler who lives by clandestine means, has neither income nor expenditure.
E.
निर्, आय income, व्यय expense, मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Not giving trouble, ready, easily attainable.
E.
निर् neg. आयास exertion.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Unarmed, defenceless.
E.
निर् neg. आयुध a weapon.

mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं)
Self-supported, not relying on another.
E.
निर्, आलम्ब stay.

mfn. (-शिः-शिः-शिः)
Without a blessing.
E.
निर्, and आशिम् blessing.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Without refuge, destitude.
E.
निर्, and आश्रय asylum.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Fasting through necessity or choice.
E.
निर् privative, आहार food.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Restless, anxious, unappeasable.
2 Homeless, portionless.
E.
निर् neg. आस्पद station.

f. (-नी)
A veil.
E.
निर् negative, अङ्ग a hint, इनि and ङीप् affs.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Imperfect, mutilated, maimed.
E.
निर् privative, इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.

n. (-णं)
1 Looking at, regarding, seeing.
2 Expecting.
E.
निर्, and ईक्षण seeing.

mfn. (-क्षन्-क्षन्ती-क्षत्)
1 Looking at, regarding.
2 Expecting, hoping.
E.
निर्, and ईक्षत् seeing.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Looking at, regarding.
2 Hoping, expecting.
E.
निर् before ईक्ष to see, शानच् aff.

f. (-क्षा)
1 Looking at, regarding.
2 Hope, expectation.
E.
निर् before ईक्ष to see, अङ् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being regarded or looked at.
E.
निर्, and ईक्ष to see, pass, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Seen, beheld, looked at.
2 Hoped, expected.
E.
निर्, and ईक्षित seen.

n. (-शं)
The body of a plough.
E.
ईश or ईष the shaft of the plough, and निर् forth or from, prefixed; hence also निरीष n. (-षं)

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Indifferent, unanxious.
E.
निर् neg. ईह who seeks.

f. (-ता)
Indifference, absence of effort or wish to get any thing.
E.
तल् added to the preceding; also with त्व, निरीहत्वं.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Said, described.
2 Obscure, obsolete.
n. (-क्तं)
1 One of the Vedāṅgas or works considered as supplementary to and connected with the Vedas, forming part of scriptural or sacred science: glossarial explanation of obscure terms, especially those occurring in the

Vedas.
2

Explanation of the concord or disagreement of letters, &c.
3 Separation or analysis of a derivative or compound word.
E.
निर् negative or affirmative prefix, उक्त spoken, said.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 The Vedāṅga or portion of scriptural science, which explains obscure and obsolete terms.
2 Explanation of words: see the last.
E.
निर्, and उक्ति saying.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being uttered or said.
E.
निर्, and उच्यमान being spoken.
mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)

Breathless.
2

Narrow, contracted, crowded.
E.
निर्, and उच्छास breathing.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Non-plussed, without an answer.
E.
निर्, and उत्तर an answer.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Indolent, indifferent.
E.
निर् neg. उत्साह effort.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unanxious, unregretting.
E.
निर् neg. उत्सुक sorrowing for.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Stopped, checked, restrained, hindered.
2 Confined, imprisoned.
E.
नि, and रुद्ध hindered.

m. (-शः)
Stricture of the urethra.
E.
निरुद्ध, and प्रकश what pains.

mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति)
Wearied, tired.
E.
निरुद्ध, and शमवृत्ति repose.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Immoveable, undecaying.
E.
निर्, and उद्द्राव going away.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
Sedate, free from perturbation.
E.
निर्, and उद्विग्न perturbed.

mfn. (-गः-गी-गं)
Causeless, groundless.
E.
निर् negative, उद्योग cause.

mfn. (-न्धन्-न्धती-न्धत्)
Hindering, checking, suppressing.
E.
नि before रुध to hinder, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Hindering, opposing.
2 Preventing, depriving of.
E.
नि before रुध to hinder, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Free from any national distress or affliction, free from tyranny.
E.
निर्, and उपद्रव violence.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
Free from trouble or alarm.
E.
निर्, and उपप्लव calamity.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Unequalled, having no resemblance or likeness.
E.
निर्, and उपमा similitude.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Honest, free from trick or fraud.
E.
निर्, and उपेक्षा trick.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Conventional, accepted, (as the meaning of technical words or names in opposition to their etymological sense alone.)
2

Unmarried.
3

Inherent.
m. (-ढः)
1 The force or application of words, according to their natural or received meanings, (in Rhetoric.)
2 (In Logic,) The implied description of any property in the term designing it, (as of redness in the word red, &c.)
E.
नि affix, and रूढ ascended; or निर् neg. ऊढ married.

n. (-णं)
1 Sight, seeing.
2 Doubt, discussion, investigation.
3 Ascertaining, determining.
4 Searching, looking for.
E.
नि implying certainty, रूप to have form, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be discussed, to be investigated.
2 To be sought or looked for.
E.
नि before रूप to have form, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यन्)
1 Searching, looking for.
2 Investigating, considering.
E.
नि, रूप to have form, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Seen, beheld.
2

Ascertained.
3

Discovered, found.
4 Appointed, deputed, directed to do any thing.
5 Considered, weighed.
E.
नि before रूप to have form, affix क्त.

mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं)
To be seen or ascertained.
ind.
Having seen or considered.
E.
नि before रूप to have form, यत् or ल्यप् aff.

n. (-त्वं)
Ascertaining, determining.
E.
त्व added to the last; also with तल्, निरूप्यता.

m. (-हः)
1 A complete sentence, one having no ellipsis.
2 Certainty, ascertainment.
3 Logick, disputation.
4 An enema, one not of an oily kind.
E.
निर् privative, and ऊह reasoning, &c.

Ascertaining.
2

Administering enemata not of an oily kind.
E.
निर् before ऊह to reason, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
Silent, noiseless.
E.
नि neg. रेभ sounding.

m. (-धः)
1 Loss, destruction.
2 Opposition, hindrance, check, restraint, prevention.
3 Aversion, disfavour, dislike.
4

Preserving.
5

Confinement.
E.
नि before रुध to oppose, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Free from violence, tyranny, &c.
m. (-तिः)
A demigod and ruler of the south-west quarter: see नैरृति.
f. (-तिः)
1 Misfortune, calamity.
2 Security, prosperity, immunity from tyranny or violence.
E.
निर् implying reverse, ऋति good fortune, &c.

m. (-थः)
The Sāma Veda.
E.
निर्, ऋ to go, Uṇādi affix थक्.

m. (-र्गः)
Country, region, place or province.
E.
निर् forth, गम to go, affix ड.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gone out or forth.
2 Expended, extinct, departed.
E.
निर् out, गत gone.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Inodorous, void of fragrance or smell.
E.
निर् neg. गन्ध smell.

n. (-नं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
निर् affirmative particle, गन्ध to hurt, affix ल्युट्.

f. (-ष्पी)
The Simel or silk cotton tree.
E.
निर्गन्ध, पुष्प a flower, ङीष् aff.

m. (-मः)
1 Going forth or out, exit.
2 Total loss or departure.
E.
निर् out, and गम going; also निर्गमन and निर्गति.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Void of all properties.
2 Bad, worthless, having no good qualities.
m. (-णः)
The Supreme Being, or any deity so considered.
E.
निर् privative, and गुण a property, an excellence.

n. (-त्वं)
The state of being free from all qualities, an attribute especially of the Supreme Being.
E.
निर्गुण, and त्व affix; also with तल्, निर्गुणता.

f. (-ण्ठी)
1 A shrub, (Vitex negundo.)
2 Another plant, (नीलशेफालिका.)
3 The root of the lotus.
E.
निर् forth or out, गुठि^1 or गुडि to surround, क affix fem. affix ङीष्; hence also निर्गुण्डी f. (-ण्डा.)
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161210. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 306. note: refer to root guWa.

m. (-ढः)
